facts.fact: A Land at Scale pilot with Oxfam, Kadaster International and FAO equips the cadastre directorate with tablets and GNSS receivers in two pilot zones, N'Djamena 7th arrondissement and Linia, and the data collected will feed the base of the land one-stop shop (GIRAF), the ministry (MATUH) saying it is not a land registration.
